**What actually works for your deployment:**
- Check the team's secrets manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, 1Password, etc.)
- Ask the previous user directly when they're back
- Have your team lead or the service owner provision you your own key
- Check your team's documentation for where credentials are stored

If you're legitimately on the infra team, any of those routes will be faster and more appropriate than pulling a key out of a chat log anyway.
